organization.description: The organization whose Cloud Security Command Center the Big Query Export Config lives in.
organization.security_impact: If organization is not correctly set or outside the allowed list, exports may expose findings to unauthorized scopes.
organization.rationale: Restricting allowed organizations ensures findings are only exported within trusted boundaries.
organization.compliant: Organization matches an approved/allowed organization ID.
organization.non-compliant: Organization is missing, incorrect, or not part of the allowed organization list.

big_query_export_id.description: This must be unique within the organization.
big_query_export_id.security_impact: If not unique or not approved, exports may overwrite or conflict, leading to loss or corruption of findings.
big_query_export_id.rationale: Each export must have a unique and controlled identifier to ensure reliable tracking.
big_query_export_id.compliant: Export ID is unique and part of the approved allowlist (e.g., scc_export_prod_australia-southeast1).
big_query_export_id.non-compliant: Export ID is missing, duplicated, or not in the approved list.

description.description: The description of the notification config (max of 1024 characters).

dataset.description: The dataset to write findings' updates to. Its format is "projects/[projectId]/datasets/[bigquery_dataset_id]". BigQuery Dataset unique ID must contain only letters (a-z, A-Z), numbers (0-9), or underscores (_).
dataset.security_impact: If dataset is not properly configured or approved, findings may be written to insecure or unauthorized locations.
dataset.rationale: Dataset configuration must be restricted to approved BigQuery datasets to ensure data integrity and access control.
dataset.compliant: Dataset matches the approved project and dataset ID.
dataset.non-compliant: Dataset is missing, invalid, or not in the approved list.

filter.description: Expression that defines the filter to apply across create/update events of findings. The expression is a list of zero or more restrictions combined via logical operators AND and OR. Parentheses are supported, and OR has higher precedence than AND. Restrictions have the form <field> <operator> <value> and may have a - character in front of them to indicate negation. The fields map to those defined in the corresponding resource. The supported operators are: * = for all value types. * >, <, >=, <= for integer values. * :, meaning substring matching, for strings. The supported value types are: * string literals in quotes. * integer literals without quotes. * boolean literals true and false without quotes. See Filtering notifications for information on how to write a filter.
